name: 音声操作PCアシスタント（スマホで挙動確認可能）
tagline: Run your PC by voice from your phone, with risky actions blocked
description: Tell your computer what to do from another room and it listens. Routine commands like muting run as a local script so almost nothing reaches the AI, while bigger asks go to the bot and the result lands on your phone. Risky operations are blocked, the access key is stored encrypted on the PC, setup is one manual step.
author: XARX_ZERO
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
